title: SrvStatus
description: This Automatically Sends A Message To The Channel Specififed In A Specific Guild When It Starts Or Stops In Discord!
body:
# SrvStatus

## Configuration Help & Info

- > TOKEN: "0000"
- > GuildID: "0000"
- > ChannelID: "0000"
- > Online: "The Server Is Online!"
- > Offline: "The Server Is Offline!"
- > Title: "SrvStatus"
- > OfflineColor: "Red"
- > OnlineColor: "Green"
- > OfflineFooter: "| Powered By | SrvStatus |"
- > OnlineFooter: "| Powered By | SrvStatus |"
- > **All Of These Fields Are Configurable To Whatever You Like, But TOKEN & GuildID & ChannelID Are Highly Required For This Plugin To Work.**
